evidence.api_compatibility: No API changes. Only two markdown files were touched. No schema, protocol, CLI contract, or persistence format was altered.
evidence.documentation: The PR correctly documents the fix for #3537 by replacing 'open directly from disk' with 'serve over localhost'. The linked issue context (CORS rejection from Origin: null on file:// URLs) is accurate — lemond's default allowed_origins does block file:// origins. The only gap is the missing --bind 127.0.0.1 flag, noted above under Security.
evidence.manual_release_testing: No manual release testing needed. The commit changes only markdown files under examples/ — no API, CLI, GUI, config, or installed artifact is affected.
evidence.post_approval_commits: None. The PR contained one commit (e0e01c1) and no commits were added after either approval. The review timeline is clean.
evidence.review: PR #3547 was approved by @abn (LGTM, submitted 2026-09-11T16:00:15Z) and @superm1 (approval, submitted 2026-09-11T16:39:17Z). @abn's subject area includes telemetry, sandboxing, and http; @superm1's includes security, linux packaging, and containers — both reviewers have relevant expertise. Codex (automated) raised a valid security concern in an inline comment noting that python3 -m http.server defaults to binding on all interfaces (not just localhost) per its --help docs, and suggested --bind 127.0.0.1. @superm1 reacted with a laugh emoji to Codex's 'keep the sweet workaround local' quote but neither reviewer requested the --bind fix nor re-reviewed after that comment. The PR was merged shortly after @superm1's approval with no renewed review of the security gap.
evidence.security: The merged instructions say 'python3 -m http.server 8080' without --bind 127.0.0.1. Per python3 -m http.server --help, the default is to bind on all interfaces, so any user who runs the command in their Downloads or Desktop folder exposes every file in that directory to the network. The PR title says 'Serve example HTML demos over localhost' which sets an expectation of localhost-only exposure that the instructions do not fulfill. Both reviewers have security expertise (@superm1: 'security', @abn: 'sandboxing, http') yet the gap was not caught.
evidence.tests: This PR changes only documentation files (examples/README.md, examples/debate-arena.md). No tests are expected for pure documentation changes, and no existing tests were weakened or deleted.

maintainer_todos.text: Add --bind 127.0.0.1 to the python3 -m http.server 8080 commands in examples/README.md and examples/debate-arena.md, then confirm the examples serve only on localhost.

subject: Serve example HTML demos over localhost instead of opening from disk (#3547)
summary: Updates example documentation to tell users to serve HTML demo files over a local HTTP server instead of opening them via file://, fixing a CORS/origin rejection (#3537).
verdict_reason: The PR title promises localhost-only serving but the instructions use python3 -m http.server without --bind 127.0.0.1, so users following the docs would inadvertently expose their file tree on all network interfaces.
